control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve right; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: on black curve left, else curve right.

scenarios.coded_response: On black it curves left (10 % / 40 %), otherwise it curves right (40 % / 10 %).

scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the wall is ahead.

scenarios.coded_response: It curves forward to the right, wheels at 40 % and 20 %.
scenarios.initial_condition: In dim light, inside a tunnel, with no line on the floor and nothing in front of the robot.
scenarios.trigger: The left light sensor reads below 70 %.
scenarios.title: Drives straight through the dark tunnel
assumptions: You said there is no line in the tunnel, so only the light decides there.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight through the tunnel without touching its walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It checks for an obstacle, then follows the line: left on black, right otherwise.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line that runs into a tunnel and out into bright light again.
scenarios.trigger: The light rises above 70 % near the tunnel's exit.
scenarios.title: Follows the line again after the tunnel
assumptions: The line the robot comes in on runs through the tunnel and out.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line again after the tunnel.

uncertainties: You said the robot drives straight in the dark, but the program curves to the right there (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 %).
In dim light the program never reads the obstacle sensor, so it cannot stop at a wall in the dark.
The light threshold of 70 % makes the robot leave the line 7.5 cm inside the tunnel and look for it 7.5 cm before the exit.
A robot that follows a line into a tunnel needs the line to get in, so a tunnel without a line cannot be reached by following one.
Coming out of the dark the robot may be off the line, so following the line again may fail for a correct program too.
